_comment: Aura token: "At the start of your turn, destroy this, then your next attack this turn gets go again." INCOMPLETE — the destroy is modelled, the go-again grant is not. It needs a one-shot "next attack gains <keyword>" primitive: MODIFY_NEXT_ATTACK is correctly one-shot but carries power mods only, and a plain SET_FLAG + flag-gated static (the shape a deleted duplicate in ako/ used) grants go again to EVERY attack for the rest of the turn, which is worse than granting none. Same missing primitive as driving_blade_red / nerve_scalpel — see docs/reaudit_opus_batch1.md.
